title: Calorie-Conscious Crispy Chickpea Wedge Salad
subtitle: with Avocado and Toasted Almonds
description: Think eating light means eating boring? Not in our book! This calorie-conscious recipe has all the punchy flavour and excitement you’d expect from us, with less than 599 calories per serve.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Check your avocado is ripe before starting the recipe (see Kitchen notes). Thinly slice the cucumber. Finely chop the tomato. Trim the lettuce, then cut into wedges (see Kitchen notes). Coarsely chop the avocado. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Toast almonds: Put the almonds in a cold medium frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan.

Char chickpeas: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in the same pan over medium-high heat. Add the chickpeas and 1 tsp Italian seasoning and cook, stirring, for 3 mins or until slightly charred. Remove the pan from the heat.
Dress salad: Combine 2 tsp olive oil and 2 tsp red wine vinegar in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the tomato, avocado and cucumber and gently toss to combine.

Serve up: Put 2 tbs vegan mayonnaise and 2 tsp water in a bowl, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Divide the lettuce wedges among plates and top with the chickpeas and salad. Drizzle with the mayonnaise mixture, scatter over the toasted almonds and enjoy!

Kitchen notes: To speed up the ripening process, put the avocado in a paper bag with a banana, close loosely, then leave on the kitchen bench for a day or two. ~ We have served this salad with big wedges of cos lettuce. If you prefer a chopped-style salad, simply shred the lettuce and toss with the chickpeas and salad.
